purpose: Step 2 only: target reconstruction and design diagnostics, no inferential estimator

CORE.selection: Q1 original two primary standardized contrasts; Q2 overall standardized difference; all originally defined supported Q3 standardized contrasts
CORE.role: main retrospective reliability family, not preregistered before descriptive results

AUX.selection: Corresponding raw differences, raw-minus-standardized changes, and all five Q2 era raw differences
AUX.role: auxiliary retrospective explanation, recent period included without selecting its sign

ROLLING.selection: All 36 Q2 year-standardized ten-year-window differences, in chronological order
ROLLING.role: joint curve, not 36 independent replications or a change-point test

CONDITIONAL.selection: All supported adjusted Q3 directed home-opponent rate cells, not all pairwise differences between cells
CONDITIONAL.role: exploratory conditional-rate atlas; sparse support may fail later method acceptance

family_policy.cross_family_joint_coverage: not_claimed; four 95% familywise statements are not one 95% global statement
family_policy.unsupported_targets: keep in full catalogue with reason; do not fill, shorten scope or silently renormalize
family_policy.later_method_failures: retain family and failure records; no silent deletion of hard targets to claim full-family coverage
family_policy.pointwise_intervals: if produced later, label separately from requested simultaneous guarantees

sensitivity_handoff.status: scope requirements registered; do not execute or treat as interval validation in step 2
sensitivity_handoff.year_omission: Q1 two main contrasts, Q2 full-period adjusted and five-year recent raw contrast; formal exact omission/reference protocol before execution
sensitivity_handoff.common_teams: Q1 main and Q2 overall: define both-role membership and attrition before execution; population changes
sensitivity_handoff.reference: retain Q1 pooled/equal-year and weight curve; Q2 alternative era/year reference and Q3 fixed/recomputed reference need explicit separate target definitions
sensitivity_handoff.geography: Q3 three stated exceptions, historical carriers and unknowns: only evidence-grounded bounded alternatives; no imputation to fill unsupported cells
sensitivity_handoff.window: 36 fixed ten-year windows; another width is a new supplementary scale, not forecast lookback optimization
